title: “Look at all the good we can do”: Global REMAX Week Sparks Creative Ways for the Worldwide Network to Give Back
summary: REMAX offices around the world came together October 4-10 for the sixth annual Global REMAX Week, leveraging the power of the global network to make a meaningful, local impact through community service.
body_markdown:
*“Look at all the good we can do!”*


These simple lyrics created and[shared on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeQHoo0xenR/?xtok=NWF6cXY2NHdjMzQx) by Lourdes Palma, Regional Director of REMAX Guatemala, perfectly summed up the spirit of Global REMAX Week.


From supporting entrepreneurs in Argentina to raising money for breast cancer awareness in New Zealand, REMAX affiliates around the world spent the week turning compassion into action.


Now in its sixth year, Global REMAX Week brings together the network’s more than 145,000 agents in nearly 8,500 offices with a presence in more than 120 countries and territories around a shared purpose: strengthening the communities they serve. While the causes vary from country to country and office to office, the mission remains the same. Through volunteerism, fundraising, donations and hands-on service, REMAX affiliates unite around a common belief that local impact can create a global ripple effect.


That message came to life in Guatemala, where affiliates celebrated Día del Niño by creating joyful experiences for local children, complete with treats, activities and traditional piñatas. To commemorate the occasion,[the region created a song](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeQHoo0xenR/?xtok=NWF6cXY2NHdjMzQx) celebrating kindness, community and the collective impact of the REMAX network. Its chorus served as an unofficial anthem for the week:


“


*Look at all the good we can do / Come together, side by side / Helping our communities worldwide* .”


“One of the things I love most about Global REMAX Week is seeing how differently each region chooses to give back while remaining united by the same purpose,” said Shawna Gilbert, Senior Vice President of REMAX Global. “These efforts demonstrate the strength of the global network and the passion REMAX affiliates have for making a positive impact. Global REMAX Week reminds us that while we work in different markets around the world, we’re connected by a shared commitment to helping people and strengthening the communities we call home.”


Here’s a look at how regions around the world made an impact during Global REMAX Week.


**Argentina & Uruguay**


Through Fundación Inspirar, REMAX Argentina and Uruguay supported entrepreneurs by sharing business expertise gained from more than two decades of network experience. More than 350 participants attended the region’s annual


*EMPRENDE, Transforma tu Realidad* event in Buenos Aires, where brokers and agents volunteered their time to deliver workshops, networking opportunities and practical business guidance.


“What we have most to give is what we’ve learned building our own businesses. So we share our knowledge and our time with entrepreneurs who often have nowhere else to find it,” says Dotti Peñate Sosa, CEO, REMAX Argentina/Uruguay.


**Australia**


REMAX Australia focused its efforts on supporting children and families receiving care at Queensland Children’s Hospital. Team members purchased and delivered more than 100 toys, clothing items and toiletries for hospital volunteers to distribute throughout the facility, helping bring comfort and moments of joy to young patients and their families during difficult times.


Managing Director Joel Davoren says, “This unique initiative further reflects our ongoing commitment to making a positive difference, alongside our year-round support of Make-A-Wish Australia.”


**Canada**


In Canada, REMAX Fairlane Realty in Truro, Nova Scotia, donated Winter Warming Kits and Hygiene Kits to United Way Maritimes. In White Rock, British Columbia, agents with REMAX Colonial Pacific Realty collected food for a local food bank and raised more than $15,000 for a children’s backpack program. Meanwhile, REMAX Realtron Turn Key in Newmarket, Ontario incorporated Global REMAX Week into its annual client appreciation events, distributing pies, hosting a community carnival and collecting 348 pounds of food and $555 for the Newmarket Food Pantry.


**Cayman Islands**


REMAX Cayman Islands continued its long-standing support of the Breast Cancer Foundation. Affiliates participated in the Foundation’s first Flag Day initiative, supported fundraising events – ultimately raising more than $500,000 USD – and helped raise awareness for breast cancer patients and their families across the Cayman Islands.


“Being part of REMAX means being part of something much bigger than real estate,” says James Bovell, broker-owner, REMAX Cayman Islands. “It’s about bringing people together, giving back to the communities that support us, and using the strength of our global network to make a positive difference locally.”


**El Salvador**


With participation from more than 200 agents, REMAX El Salvador prepared 4,000 meals for families of hospitalized children, donated essential supplies to vulnerable youth and supported community development initiatives across the country. The effort united offices throughout the network around a shared goal of serving those most in need.


“Behind every cause, there are people, families and stories that deserve attention,” says Michelle Zablah, Regional Director, El Salvador.


**Honduras**


In Honduras, REMAX affiliates supported CRICOL, a rehabilitation center serving people with disabilities, through a community charity run and financial contribution of $1,500.. The initiative helped advance the organization’s mission of inclusion, rehabilitation and advocacy.


Alejandra Cruz, Regional Director of Honduras, says a highlight was seeing residents come together around a shared cause, demonstrating the power of community partnerships to create meaningful local impact.

**Italy**


Across Italy, REMAX affiliates supported children and families through two separate initiatives. In Busto Arsizio, the team at REMAX Platinum joined thousands of participants in the Race for Hope benefiting pediatric cancer research, while in Syracuse, the Zenit Team at REMAX City Home helped create a play area for children visiting a local hospital emergency department. Together, the projects reflected a shared commitment to bringing comfort, care and hope to local communities.


As Dario Castiglia, CEO & Founder of REMAX Italy, notes, “A company’s value is measured not only by its professional achievements but also by its ability to make a positive impact on the local community and support initiatives that genuinely improve people’s lives.”


**Japan**


In Japan, REMAX NOW continued a community cleanup initiative that began during the inaugural Global REMAX Week in 2021 and has grown from a single-office project into a multi-office effort involving approximately 40 affiliates cleaning up three locations over three days.


“While affiliates work independently day to day, this week brings everyone together under the shared goal of contributing to society,” shares Broker/Owner Nobutaka Tan.


**New Zealand**


To mark Breast Cancer Awareness Month, REMAX New Zealand hosted a Pink Ribbon Morning Tea benefiting Breast Cancer Foundation NZ. More than 100 agents, clients, family members and community supporters participated in the fundraiser, helping advance breast cancer education, research and patient support.


“Knowing that REMAX offices all over the world are doing the same thing at the same time is a special feeling,” says Mala Maharaj, CEO of REMAX New Zealand.”It reminds us that we’re part of something much bigger than ourselves.”


**Panama**


REMAX Panama continued its investment in education by supporting underprivileged schools and funding scholarships for promising students. The initiative has helped create opportunities for students pursuing brighter futures through academic achievement.


“Through education you can change not only one person’s life, but their entire family’s future,” says Tatiana Castro, regional director, Panama & Puerto Rico


**Portugal**


REMAX Portugal partnered with a public hospital to transform a new maternity unit, painting and decorating six delivery rooms and common spaces to create a warmer environment for growing families. The project reflected the region’s belief that every family’s story begins with a welcoming place to call home.


“At REMAX, everything starts with a home. And in a way, a maternity unit is the very first home every baby will ever know,” says CEO of REMAX Portugal Beatriz Rubio.


**South Africa**


In South Africa, REMAX Coast and Country collected 72 “Jars of Hope” filled with meal ingredients for local church feeding programs. The initiative provided practical support for individuals and families facing food insecurity while demonstrating the power of small acts of kindness.


Michelle Angelique Adcock, an agent with the office, led the initiative and shares, “Behind every jar is more than a meal. It is a small act of kindness, a moment of relief, and a message that says: You matter. Your community cares.”


**United States**


In the United States, REMAX Gateway in Northern Virginia coordinated 11 volunteer projects, from packing food and clothing donations to working with preschoolers and helping at a family shelter, before closing the week by raising more than $6,300 for the Walk to End Alzheimer’s. REMAX Results in Rhode Island stocked the shelves at a local food pantry, while REMAX Masters agents in Syracuse, New York, assembled Weekend Power Packs to help ensure middle school students have food over the weekend.


As the lyrics from Guatemala’s song remind us:


*“Pass the smile, pass it on. Keep that kindness moving on.”* During Global REMAX Week, REMAX professionals around the world did exactly that, creating local impact while strengthening the connections that make the global REMAX network one of a kind.


The next Global REMAX Week will take place October 3-9, 2027.
